    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1)
    top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]

    # The two panels encode foreground with their non-background colors.

    from collections import Counter
    top_counts = Counter(x for row in top for x in row)
